reviews.t: We really liked this product as it's really soft and works well ...
reviews.x: We really liked this product as it's really soft and works well lathering up for bathtime.  However, one of the sponges though was filled with tiny little black specks throughout.  These were embedded in the sponge itself and had to be ripped apart to get them all out.  There were so many, I gave up. No idea what they were, but don't think I want little black specks all over my baby during bathtime!  If this happens naturally during the sponge's growth, the company should have had better quality

reviews.t: Soft, but has some brown speckles of unknown origin
reviews.x: The size of the sponge is about the size of the palm of my hand, soft and gentle enough for my baby’s eczema prone skin. I did notice some dark brown speckles on one of the sponges, they seem to be naturally occurring discoloration, hence 3 stars. Otherwise, great product.

Maybe I just got a defective batch, but these sponges are terrible. I used one for myself and kept one for my 4 year old daughter. I used the sponge one time, with a fairly gentle buffing motion. The sponge felt soft in my hand, but now my body is covered in tiny scratches that burn like a cat scratch and I also had tiny slivers in my hand like nettle stingers that I had to pick out with tweezers. I’m just thankful I hadn’t used it on my daughter first! I have pretty sensitive skin, but this is
Not sure what the brown bits are in the sponge. I’ve been soaking for hours and they keep falling out. I got a 2 pack and the other sponge was perfect. I don’t want to use this on my baby. Returning.
These sponges are falling appart, I could use them only 5 times and had to throw them away.

Arrived ahead of schedule. Each sea sponge is great quality and pretty good size, close to 4” at the longest diameter. No hard bits or bugs like other brands. Best used dry against the skin for max exfoliating, but not as abrasive as veggie lufa. I would buy this for light scrubbing but anything more forceful would probably wear it down faster. I’ve read you should replace them every 1-3 months anyway, but for the price, we’ll see!

reviews.t: Seems like a good deal but the sponges are very small
reviews.x: Seems like a good deal but the sponges are very small, and fell apart in a couple of weeks.

It says all good things , from nature. But it doesn't say clear instructions about what you need to do before first use. Moms, please check carefully before use on your babies. There were small tiny chips fall off and stuck on my hands and my baby's body. It's very painful and hard to get off from my hands . I want my money back but I don't want to return it, because I don't know if they are going to resell to other people.So I'm going to throw away.

This is perfect for my baby’s bath! I want one for myself too!!  This is so soft for my baby and really glides nicely. My mother in law suggested this for my baby’s bath and she was right! The wash clothes are too coarse—even the soft ones. This is very durable too!
Loved these natural sponges extremely soft, great lather & rinsed out and dried quickly. Perfect size for a baby I'm sure...
One of the sponges was very small and useless. The other felt apart after one use.

I appreciate that a sponge is a natural product, but there appears to be little in the way of quality control, to make sure only suitable sponges are sent out. 1 of the 2 had a (natural) hole in the middle of it, but it meant that within a month of light use it completely fell apart, leaving small pieces of sponge everywhere.

reviews.t: ... gentle enough for a baby and the size is perfect. They get sudsy
reviews.x: These sponges are gentle enough for a baby and the size is perfect.  They get sudsy, rinse out and dry nicely.

reviews.t: Good size, durable, and soft when wet
reviews.x: We have tried a few different brands of sponges for our little ones - so far these are the best by far!  With other sponges, we have encountered multiple issues - lack of ability to lather, disintegration, extremely tiny, or any combination of those.  While I wouldn't call these perfect, they have held up better, lather well, and are a good size to hold and scrub the kids with.  That said - no sponge is ever perfect.  They do break down over time, but the price is reasonable enough that it doesn

It was my first time buying it, so I thought it would be bigger and at least the same size. The sponge would leave little pieces in the bath, so I don’t know if  it’s a natural thing, but sure didn’t like it. The softness gets better after it gets wet, so it a good side. Will I buy again? Maybe. But I would love a clarification about the little specks it leaves in the water first.

reviews.t: Do not recommend. Please check sponges
reviews.x: Bought this to bathe my premature baby and notice particles floating in the water. At first I thought it was ants but once I opened the sponge whatever it is is throughout the sponge. I opened the unused on and it was the same thing. I’m so nervous I gave her another bath with fresh water and wash cloth. I’m so nervous again I do not know what exactly is in the sponge.

reviews.t: The sponge is perfect size for my hand
reviews.x: The sponge is perfect size for my hand! I love love love the way it lathers up and doesnt feel horribly rough like the usual store bought loofah sponges.  While I do not have a baby at home, I am enjoying it for myself and I gave the second one to my daughter who loves it as well!

I am looking for a natural bath sponge that last long, this one suits my needs perfectly! I bought many other natural ones from other shops, all start to break apart within one or two months. This one is much steadier, while still have gentle touch to the skin. Great for value!

At first I thought these were too small.  I bought them for my kids 7 and 4.  They foam up the soap nicely and my kids love them.  Perfect size for their little hands.  They have lasted a very long time and hold up really well.

I got the two pack. The one on the right side of my picture is perfect. Soft and easy to get a lot of bubble out of the body soap. However on the left one, there’s a few black/dark brown particles. I won’t use it on my baby.

These are fantastic! A baby washcloth is a bit to small and a pain to use with only one hand...these sponges are the answer. They dry quickly and you can get a lot or a little water, perfect for GENTLY scrubbing baby.

reviews.t: 1 sponge cut in half. Save money and dont buy this double pack.
reviews.x: The sponge itself is fine but you pay extra for "2" and its literally 1 sponge cut in half. don't waste your money on this particular double pack. Its smaller than the size of the palm of my hand.
This is my everything at bath time since the baby was born, she has a very sensitive skin and this is just the cherry on top of the cake, gentle and so soft. Definitely buying over and over again. 💯
Mistakenly ordered the baby sponges instead of the face ones—but this sponge worked fabulously on my face. It also rinsed well, which is important for a product I’ll reuse on my face.

reviews.t: Very soft and perfect for bathing my triplets
reviews.x: Very soft and perfect for bathing my triplets. I love that they are all natural. I did receive the product at a discount for my review but my reviews are always honest.

claims.text: Many reviewers find the sponges soft and gentle, especially suitable for baby baths and sensitive skin.
Several reviewers report the sponges falling apart or disintegrating after short use.
Multiple reviewers found dark brown or black specks embedded in the sponges.
Some reviewers note the sponges are smaller than expected.
A few reviewers experienced skin irritation or small chips/pieces coming off onto skin.
